text: dsh-peak-badge 是供 DSH 网页使用的 DeepSeek 峰谷计价角标，通过 client 插件挂入 shell.overlay，按北京时间显示当前处于高峰或优惠时段，并每 30 秒更新。用户可以拖动角标并点击查看时段和参考价格详情；拖动位置保存在浏览器本地。适合希望随时查看当前计价时段的 DSH 网页用户。

dsh-peak-badge adds a floating DeepSeek pricing badge to the DSH web UI. It shows the current Beijing-time peak or off-peak period, refreshes every 30 seconds, and opens a detail card with time windows and reference prices. Drag the badge to reposition it; the browser stores its position locally.
想在 DSH 网页上随时看到 DeepSeek 现在是高峰计价还是优惠计价。
Show me whether DeepSeek is currently in its peak or off-peak pricing window while I use DSH.
我想把 DeepSeek 峰谷计价提示拖到网页里不挡内容的位置。
dsh-peak-badge 的功能「峰谷时段悬浮提示」：在 DSH 网页角标显示当前北京时间及 DeepSeek 高峰或优惠计价状态，并每 30 秒刷新；点击角标可展开时段和参考价详情。

dsh-peak-badge README · dsh-peak-badge：A floating **DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing badge** for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Harness) (DSH) web GUI. It tells you at a glance whether DeepSeek tokens are currently billed at peak or off-peak rates — based on **Beijing time**, with zero configuration.

> 🟢 **Off-peak hours** — light green pill: 「优惠时段 · 半价」 (off-peak, half price)
> 🟠 **Peak hours** (09:00–12:00, 14:00–18:00 Beijing time) — light orange pill: 「高峰时段 · 单价×2」 (peak, 2× price)

dsh-peak-badge README · Why：DeepSeek introduced peak/off-peak pricing (峰谷计费) on 2026-08-17: during the peak windows **09:00–12:00** and **14:00–18:00** (Beijing time), token prices are **2×** the off-peak rate. This badge keeps that status visible at all times so you can decide whether to keep chatting or defer the expensive work.

dsh-peak-badge README · Features：- **Always current** — refreshes every 30 s using `Intl.DateTimeFormat('Asia/Shanghai')` (no manual timezone setup).
- **Draggable** — move it anywhere; the position is remembered in `localStorage` and clamped to the viewport.
- **Click for details** — a card shows the current Beijing time, the peak/off-peak windows, and reference prices for DeepSeek V4-Flash / V4-Pro.
- **Zero host risk** — pure browser plugin; the host half is a no-op.
- Complements the text-rule reminder in `AGENTS.md` for agents working in basecamp-style repositories.

dsh-peak-badge README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-peak-badge
```

Restart `dsh web`, then hard-refresh the browser (Cmd+Shift+R on macOS / Ctrl+Shift+R elsewhere). The badge appears at the bottom-left by default — drag it wherever you like.

dsh-peak-badge README · Usage：- **See status**: green = off-peak, orange = peak. The pill also shows the current Beijing time.
- **Drag**: press and hold, move, release. Position persists across refreshes.
- **Details**: click (without dragging) to open/close the info card.

dsh-peak-badge README · Reference prices (effective 2026-08-17, CNY per million tokens)：| Model | Peak input / output | Off-peak input / output |
| --- | --- | --- |
| V4-Flash | ¥3.0 / ¥9.0 | ¥1.5 / ¥4.5 |
| V4-Pro | ¥9.0 / ¥27.0 | ¥4.5 / ¥13.5 |

Cache hits are billed at half the input price. Always check the official pricing page: https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing

```

dsh-peak-badge README · dsh-peak-badge：[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Harness)(DSH)web 界面的**峰谷计价状态角标**:一眼看出当前 DeepSeek token 是按高峰价还是优惠价计费——以**北京时间**为准,零配置。

> 🟢 **优惠时段** —— 浅绿胶囊:「优惠时段 · 半价」
> 🟠 **高峰时段**(北京时间 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00)—— 浅橘胶囊:「高峰时段 · 单价×2」
dsh-peak-badge README · 为什么需要它：DeepSeek 自 2026-08-17 起实行峰谷计费:高峰窗口(北京时间 **09:00–12:00**、**14:00–18:00**)的 token 单价为**优惠时段的 2 倍**。本插件把这一状态全天候摆在眼前,让你决定是继续聊,还是把费钱的活儿挪到优惠时段。

dsh-peak-badge README · 特性：- **实时准确** —— 每 30 秒用 `Intl.DateTimeFormat('Asia/Shanghai')` 刷新,无需手动设置时区
- **随意拖动** —— 拖到任何位置,位置记忆在 `localStorage`,且不会拖出屏幕
- **点击看详情** —— 详情卡显示当前北京时间、高峰/优惠窗口、V4-Flash / V4-Pro 参考价
- **零 host 风险** —— 纯浏览器插件,host 半是 no-op
- 与仓库级 `AGENTS.md` 里的「峰谷计价提醒」文字规则互补:规则管提问时机,角标管全天候可见

dsh-peak-badge README · 安装：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-peak-badge
```

重启 `dsh web`,硬刷新浏览器(macOS:Cmd+Shift+R;其他:Ctrl+Shift+R)。角标默认出现在左下角,拖到哪都行。

dsh-peak-badge README · 用法：- **看状态**:绿 = 优惠,橘 = 高峰;胶囊上同时显示当前北京时间
- **拖动**:按住移动,松开即固定;位置跨刷新保持
- **详情**:原地点击(不拖动)展开/收起信息卡

dsh-peak-badge README · 参考价(2026-08-17 起生效,元/百万 tokens)：| 模型 | 高峰 输入/输出 | 优惠 输入/输出 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| V4-Flash | ¥3.0 / ¥9.0 | ¥1.5 / ¥4.5 |
| V4-Pro | ¥9.0 / ¥27.0 | ¥4.5 / ¥13.5 |

缓存命中按输入价减半计费。以官方定价页为准:https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing
